chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:
“The man is banished when his hand is cut.”

key_terms.إِذَا: when; indicating the condition for the ruling
key_terms.قُطِعَ: his hand was cut; referring to the carried-out hadd punishment
key_terms.يُنْفَى: is banished or exiled as a legal penalty
key_terms.ٱلرَّجُلُ: the man subject to the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is a thief banished after the hadd punishment of cutting is carried out?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the punishment of theft. It indicates that banishment is applied to the man after the cutting punishment has been carried out.
